english translation text:

HOW WILL ZAINAB GO TO DAMASCUS, TIED IN ROPES?

arabic text:
KYA KARUN YE TO BATA BHAI NAHI SAR PE RIDA
SAR PE BABA BHI NAHI KAUN SUNE MERI SADA
HUKM ZAALIM KA HAI DARBAR MEIN AAYE ZAINAB
english translation text:
WHAT SHOULD I DO, O BROTHER, WHEN I HAVE NO HEAD COVERING?
I ALSO DO NOT HAVE MY FATHER (ALI AS), WHO CAN HEAR MY LAMENTATION
THE OPPRESSOR HAS ORDERED ZAINAB TO ENTER THE PALACE
